strongest_angle: Examines October 2026 findings from Purdue University and McKinsey showing how human communication skills and problem-solving outrank AI proficiency in modern hiring.

key_facts.fact: Purdue University published an article on October 9, 2026, authored by RM Barton, addressing whether communication skills remain important in the age of artificial intelligence.
Purdue Global published a report on October 13, 2026, citing McKinsey research that existing AI and related technologies could automate tasks accounting for more than half of all U.S. work hours.
The 2026 GMAC Corporate Recruiters Survey surveyed over 600 global employers, finding that 64 percent named communication as the most in-demand skill for business school graduates.
Mark George published an analysis on October 13, 2026, through Masters in Communications examining the Purdue University findings on communication majors and AI tools.
